prompt: A warm painted animated film in an elegant olive-green restaurant kitchen. One continuous locked-off medium shot of the same silver-haired restaurant owner in his olive shirt. At the start, his left index fingertip rests against the front glass of the upright tablet. He finishes a single gentle tap, lifts the fingertip clearly away from the glass, and draws his left hand back through the empty air to rest naturally on the wooden counter beside the flat receipts. He looks at the tablet, then down at the receipts, with a small calm nod and natural breathing. The tablet remains completely rigid on its stand. The hand and fingers keep their shape throughout the action. His other hand stays resting on the bench. The receipts lie flat and still. Stable kitchen, stable lighting, restrained human movement, same face, same warm painted texture, one uninterrupted shot at normal speed.
